application_overview.name: FitGym Tool
application_overview.description: A comprehensive gym management system for gym administrators to manage members, track payments, and monitor gym operations
application_overview.purpose: Streamline gym operations including member registration, fee management, payment tracking, and business analytics
application_overview.access_method: Web-based application accessible through any modern web browser
application_overview.authentication: Microsoft Azure Active Directory login required

main_navigation.description: The application has a main navigation menu accessible after login

menu_items.name: Dashboard
menu_items.description: Main overview page with key metrics and analytics

login_process.description: How users access the FitGym Tool application

steps.action: Navigate to the FitGym Tool website
steps.description: Open your web browser and go to the application URL
You'll be redirected to Microsoft Azure login page
Use your organization's Microsoft account credentials
You'll be redirected back to the FitGym Tool dashboard

requirements: Valid Microsoft Azure Active Directory account
Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

dashboard_functionality.description: Main overview page showing key gym metrics and quick access to features

components.name: Current Revenue Widget
components.description: Shows revenue metrics for the current month

components.name: Current User Widget
components.description: Shows information about the logged-in user

main_features.name: Add New Member
main_features.description: Register new gym members with complete information
main_features.how_to_access: Navigate to Members page → Click 'Add a new member' button

steps.title: Review and Confirm
steps.description: Review all entered information before final submission

validation_rules: Email must be unique in the system
All required fields must be filled
Phone number must be valid format
Date of birth must be realistic

main_features.name: View All Members
main_features.description: Browse and search through all registered gym members
main_features.how_to_access: Navigate to Members page → View the members list table
features: Search members by name or email
View member details in expandable rows

main_features.name: Search Member by Email
main_features.description: Quickly find a specific member using their email address
main_features.how_to_access: Use the search functionality in the members list
steps: Enter the member's email address in the search box
System will filter and display matching results
Click on the member to view full details

main_features.name: Update Member Details
main_features.how_to_access: Navigate to Members page → Click 'Update an existing member details' button
steps: Search for the member by email
main_features.success_message: Member details have been updated successfully

main_features.name: Update Membership Status
main_features.how_to_access: Navigate to Members page → Click 'Update Membership status of member' button
steps: Search for the member by email
Choose new membership status from dropdown
status_options: Active - Member can use gym facilities
Inactive - Member account is temporarily disabled
Suspended - Member account is suspended due to policy violations
main_features.success_message: Membership status has been updated successfully

fees_management.description: Comprehensive fee structure management and payment tracking

main_features.name: View Current Fee Structure
main_features.description: Display the current pricing plans for different membership durations
main_features.how_to_access: Navigate to Fees page → View 'Current Fees Structure' section
displays: Effective date of current fee structure

main_features.name: Current Month Revenue Status
main_features.description: Monitor revenue and payment collection for the current month
main_features.how_to_access: Navigate to Dashboard or Fees page → View revenue widgets

main_features.name: Member Payment Status Overview
main_features.description: View payment status for all current members
main_features.how_to_access: Navigate to Fees page → View 'Current Members Fees Payment Status' section
status_indicators: Pending - Yellow indicator, payment due soon
Overdue - Red indicator, payment past due date

main_features.name: Member Payment History
main_features.description: View complete payment history for any member
main_features.how_to_access: Navigate to Fees page → Search for member → View payment history
steps: Select the member from search results

main_features.name: Update Member Fees
main_features.description: Record new fee payments for members
main_features.how_to_access: Navigate to Fees page → Select member → Click 'Update Fees' button
steps: Set payment start and end dates

ai_features.description: AI-powered tools to enhance gym management experience

main_features.name: AI Chatbot Assistant
main_features.description: Interactive AI assistant to help with gym management queries
main_features.how_to_access: Click the chat icon (usually in bottom-right corner of any page)
capabilities: SQL query assistance for data analysis
features: Sample prompt suggestions for quick start
Support for text and table responses
sample_queries: How many active members do we have?
What's our revenue for this month?
Show me members with pending payments
How do I add a new member?
What are the current fee structures?
user_interactions: Click on sample prompts to get started
Use followup questions for deeper insights

main_features.name: Bug Severity Analysis
main_features.description: AI-powered bug report system with automatic severity detection
main_features.how_to_access: Access through bug report dialog (usually via help menu or error reporting)
features: Automatic bug severity detection based on description
how_it_works: User describes the bug in title and description
AI analyzes the content to determine severity
User can accept or modify the suggestion
Bug report is submitted with proper categorization

main_features.name: AI Feature Status
main_features.description: Monitor availability and status of AI services
main_features.how_to_access: View on Dashboard → AI Features widget
displays: Quick access links to AI tools

bug_reporting.description: System for reporting issues and bugs in the application
bug_reporting.how_to_access: Click on bug report icon or access through help menu

process.title: Open Bug Report Dialog
process.description: Click the bug report button to open the reporting form

process.title: Get AI Severity Suggestion
process.description: After filling title and description, click 'Get Bug Severity' for AI analysis

process.title: Review and Submit
process.description: Review all information and submit the bug report

severity_levels: Low - Minor issues that don't affect core functionality
Medium - Moderate issues that may impact user experience
High - Major issues that significantly affect functionality
Critical - Severe issues that prevent system use
bug_reporting.success_message: The Bug report has been successfully submitted

Click Submit to create member account

Click on the member's payment update button
Verify payment status updates in the list

Check that member status updates to 'Paid'

steps: Navigate to Fees page for detailed breakdown

Type your question in natural language

possible_causes: Account not authorized for FitGym Tool
solutions: Try different browser or clear browser cache

issues.cause: Attempting to register member with duplicate email
issues.solution: Use a different email address or update existing member record

solutions: Verify payment amount is positive number
Wait and retry after a few minutes
Use sample prompts to test functionality

issues.problem: Data not loading or showing as empty
possible_causes: No data available for the selected criteria
solutions: Verify data exists for the time period

best_practices.description: Recommended practices for optimal use of FitGym Tool

recommendations: Always double-check member email addresses for accuracy
Use consistent naming conventions for member names
Verify phone numbers include proper country/area codes
Keep member addresses complete and up-to-date
Set realistic membership start dates
Record payments promptly after collection
Verify payment amounts match current fee structure
Set accurate payment period dates
Regularly review overdue payments list
Follow up with members on pending payments
Log out properly when finished using the system
Use the AI chatbot for quick information lookup
Report bugs immediately when encountered
Keep browser updated for best performance
Use search functionality to quickly find members
Never share login credentials with others
Log out when leaving workstation unattended
Verify member identity before updating information
Handle member data according to privacy policies
Report any suspicious activity immediately
